messages:
Maya Chen: FYI — Acme notified they moved billing to Acme EU Ltd and want Elena Novak (elena.novak@acme-eu.com) to sign renewal. Need vendor code, invoice entity, and e-sign flow cleared before EOD.
Rafael Ortiz: Sales okayed a 10% renewal concession. Confirmed with manager; I'll log the approval in CRM.
Alina (Finance): We need vendor code and PO to match invoices. Can they provide vendor code now and PO by tomorrow? Net30 requested.
Maya Chen: Vendor code provided: ACME-EU-2026. PO expected tomorrow morning but not guaranteed. They asked for Net30 and no prorate on 12mo seats.
Jordan Patel: Switching signer across legal entities requires a short amendment to MSA. I'll draft a one-paragraph amendment that replaces signer and billing entity. ETA EOD for review.
Rafael Ortiz: If we risk losing price while legal completes sign, I can send a "pricing lock" confirmation email countersigned by Sales. Not a legal amendment but holds quote.
Alina (Finance): If PO isn't in by billing date we will charge the CC on file and re-invoice with PO when provided. Please cc finance@redwood.com on executed docs so we can apply vendor code/discount.
Maya Chen: Trying to start e-sign but our provider is rejecting the acme-eu.com domain. esign-bot threw an error.
esign-bot: [system] e-sign attempt failed for thread 1719804321: recipient domain mismatch "acme-eu.com". To retry, either add domain to allowed list or use alternate signer. Command:
```
/esign start 1719804321-acme-eu-amendment.pdf --recipients elena.novak@acme-eu.com
```
Jordan Patel: Options: ask Acme IT to whitelist our esign service for that recipient, or accept an alternate signer from Acme EU Ltd. Which does customer prefer?
Maya Chen: They've asked Elena to whitelist, and I'm also requesting a backup signer. I'll post PO scan here when it lands.
Rafael Ortiz: Drafting a brief pricing-hold email now and will post for Jordan's quick approval. :thumbsup:
Jordan Patel: Reviewed countersign text, minor edits. Pasting final below for Rafael to send.
Maya Chen: Action items: 1) Jordan to produce amendment (EOD) 2) Maya to collect PO + request whitelist 3) Rafael to prepare pricing-lock email 4) Alina to prep invoice template with vendor code + 10% discount and Net30 5) esign-bot to retry after whitelist.
Alina (Finance): Noted. Finance will process final invoice only after executed amendment + PO or will charge CC then reissue. Will confirm ledger code once executed.
Maya Chen: Thanks all — will update thread after PO or e-sign OK. :white_check_mark:
